errorCodes.meaning: The maintainer holds no credential under this identifier that this consumer may present, or holds no key for its subject that this consumer may use. Deliberately conflates the cases — see Custody scope.
The credential is revoked, suspended, outside its validity period, archived or deleted.
The maintainer cannot present a credential of this format to a named verifier.
`claims` names a claim the credential does not carry.
Every presentation of the credential discloses claims `claims` does not name — all of them, for a credential without selective disclosure. `details.undisclosed` lists those claims.

schema.description: Present one stored credential to a verifier the consumer names, bound to that verifier and a nonce it chose, disclosing only the named claims.

audience.description: The verifier the presentation is for: the `domain` of a Data Integrity presentation, the `aud` of an SD-JWT key-binding JWT.

claims.description: The names of the subject claims to disclose. Nothing outside them is disclosed; a credential that cannot disclose less than all its claims is refused unless they are all named.

id.description: Local handle from a query descriptor. Opaque; consumers must not derive or guess one.

nonce.description: The value the verifier binds the presentation to: the `nonce` of a Data Integrity presentation or of an SD-JWT key-binding JWT.

purpose.description: Optional: why the holder is presenting, recorded with the maintainer's record of the disclosure. Never sent to the verifier.
